name: Grenada

flag.description: A red border around a field divided diagonally into yellow triangles at top and bottom and green triangles at hoist and fly; a red disc with a yellow star sits in the centre, three yellow stars run along the top and bottom borders, and a nutmeg appears on the hoist triangle.
flag.symbolism: Red represents courage, yellow wisdom and warmth, and green vegetation; the seven stars stand for the seven parishes, and the nutmeg for the island's famous spice crop.

hook: Grenada, the Isle of Spice, wears a small nutmeg on its green triangle, with seven stars inside a red frame.
trivia: Grenada is known as the "Isle of Spice" and is one of the world's leading producers of nutmeg.
Off Grenada's west coast lies an underwater sculpture park, created by artist Jason deCaires Taylor from 2006.
